public_rationale: On the reading of annual losses as realized 2025 net losses, both companies were unprofitable and each exceeded $20 billion: Anthropic reported an audited $41.965 billion net loss, and reporting on OpenAI's accounts put its net loss at nearly $39 billion [e1, e2]. Both figures included large valuation-related accounting charges [e1, e2]. This supports the net-loss reading; it does not establish equivalent cash burn or operating losses, with Anthropic's 2025 operating loss at $8.060 billion [e1, e2].
limitations: The statement does not specify an accounting basis or annual period; this assessment uses calendar 2025 net losses.
The figures do not establish recurring annual losses or cash burn of the same size.
OpenAI's underlying accounts were not obtained directly; e2 provides secondary reporting.
